<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Deck</title>
<!-- One self-contained deck. `npx verseva add deck` inlines the two stylesheets below, so the
     file it writes opens from file://. Dark by default; add data-theme="light" to <html> for light.
     Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Space, Home and End move between slides; so does a swipe.
     Without scripting the slides read as one scroll; printing gives one slide per page.
     Faces: a title that states the claim, one support line, a labelled number. Sources sit
     behind the Sources control on each slide. -->
<style>
/* ============================================================================
   @verseva/design · tokens.css
   THE VERSEVA SIGNATURE. Dark default; [data-theme="light"] is the one flip
   block. Brand themes override values via [data-brand="<slug>"] blocks in
   their own theme.css (living with the brand), never by editing this file.

   Two strata in one file:
   · CRAFT  : roles, scales, states-bearing tokens. Brand-agnostic skeleton.
               Every surface, owned or partner, inherits these.
   · SIGNATURE: the soft-glass material values (glass fills, catch-light,
               navshell tiers, accent bloom). VERSEVA's own language; the
               default clothing for owned surfaces. Partner themes may
               re-value or null these (white-label: craft yes, credit no).

   Laws in force (full text: docs/laws.md): TYPE LAW (mono-is-for-machines),
   SEAM LAW (sections-must-breathe), matte-is-not-flat, hierarchy-from-fill,
   nav-tier-brightness (mode-specific), hairlines-are-decoration (contract
   boundaries come from the text ladder), one accent per view, contrast
   floors 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large + UI parts.

   Provenance: extracted 2026-08-22 from design-core token-architecture.md +
   the design board (ratified VERSEVA Design architecture, 2026-08-22).
   Zero visual change from the pre-package Baseline.
   ========================================================================= */

:root {
  color-scheme: dark;

  /* ---- CRAFT · color roles (canvas / hairline / text ladders) ---- */
  --bg: #0B0D10;
  --surface: #111318;
  --surface-2: #16181F;
  --hairline-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, .06);
  --hairline: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
  --hairline-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16);
  --text-1: #F4F5F7;
  --text-2: #9CA3AF;
  --text-3: #7A818E;

  /* ---- CRAFT · accent roles (one accent per brand; themes re-value) ---- */
  --accent: #E8352E;
  --accent-hover: #EF5A54;
  --accent-ink: #1A0605;
  --focus: #E8352E;
  --accent-2: transparent;
  --highlight: transparent;

  /* ---- CRAFT · status (never color-alone) ---- */
  --success: #8FCEA8; --success-bg: rgba(133, 199, 161, .10);
  --warn: #E3B95F;    --warn-bg: rgba(227, 185, 95, .10);
  --danger: #F2ABA0;  --danger-bg: rgba(242, 171, 160, .10);

  /* ---- CRAFT · type (the trio; themes may mandate their own faces) ---- */
  --font-sans: 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-display: 'Archivo', var(--font-sans);
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;
  --display-weight: 650;
  --heading-weight: 620;
  --btn-weight: 600;

  /* ---- CRAFT · spacing (4px base; the only source of spatial values) ---- */
  --s-1: 4px;  --s-2: 8px;  --s-3: 12px; --s-4: 16px; --s-5: 24px;
  --s-6: 32px; --s-7: 48px; --s-8: 64px; --s-9: 96px; --s-10: 128px;
  --container-prose: 65ch;
  --container-content: 72rem;
  --container-wide: 80rem;

  /* ---- CRAFT · radius (posture: soft-large; themes re-map, one posture) ---- */
  --r-sm: 10px;
  --r-md: 14px;
  --r-lg: 22px;
  --r-pill: 999px;
  --r-btn: var(--r-md);

  /* ---- CRAFT · elevation (hairline-first; shadows reinforce) ---- */
  --e-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .24);
  --e-2: 0 6px 20px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .28);
  --e-3: 0 20px 48px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .36);

  /* ---- CRAFT · motion (transform + opacity only; reduced-motion honored) ---- */
  --dur-1: 120ms; --dur-2: 200ms; --dur-3: 320ms; --dur-4: 480ms;
  --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.2, 0, 0, 1);
  --ease-emph: cubic-bezier(.3, 0, .1, 1);
  --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
  --ease-entrance: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1);
  --ease-exit: cubic-bezier(.3, 0, 1, 1);
  --ease-back: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1);

  /* ---- CRAFT · data-viz (single-hue magnitude ladder; volume, never type).
     Series identity: --data-3 (accent) is series one, --data-alt the fixed
     second hue (validator-proven CVD-safe against the accent in both modes);
     a third series folds to small multiples, never a generated hue. ---- */
  --data-0: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-1) 8%, transparent);
  --data-1: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 36%, transparent);
  --data-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 64%, transparent);
  --data-3: var(--accent);
  --data-alt: #3B82C4;
  --chart-grid: var(--hairline);
  --chart-label: var(--text-3);

  /* ---- SIGNATURE · soft-glass material (one overhead light source) ---- */
  --glass-fill-3: rgba(15, 17, 22, .70);
  --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .10);
  --glass-blur: 26px;
  --glass-sat: 1.45;
  --glass-shadow: 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5), 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6), 0 24px 60px -26px rgba(0, 0, 0, .8);
  --glass-glow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .055), 0 8px 40px -18px rgba(255, 255, 255, .11);
  --glass-inset: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .34), inset 1px 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .30), inset 0 10px 26px -16px rgba(255, 255, 255, .20);
  --surface-body: linear-gradient(168deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .07) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .022) 26%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 52%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .06) 100%);

  /* ---- SIGNATURE · navshell tiers (nav-tier-brightness law, dark = inverted:
          frame a shade LIGHTER, main pill DARKER, recessed-in) ---- */
  --nav-gap: 6px;
  --nav-frame: rgba(255, 255, 255, .11);
  --nav-main: rgba(8, 10, 13, .62);
  --nav-pill-inset: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .10), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .35), 0 2px 8px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);

  /* ---- SIGNATURE · accent bloom (generic derivations; themes may supply
          verbatim brand values) ---- */
  --accent-on: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, white);
  --accent-bloom: radial-gradient(120% 150% at 50% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) 42%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 70%, transparent 100%);
  --accent-active-glow: none; /* 1.4.0 law 3: no colored outer glow; the bloom carries the active state */
}

/* ============ LIGHT · the one flip block (nothing per-screen) ============ */
[data-theme="light"] {
  color-scheme: light;

  --bg: #F4F5F8;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --surface-2: #F1F2F6;
  --hairline-soft: rgba(15, 18, 30, .07);
  --hairline: rgba(15, 18, 30, .10);
  --hairline-strong: rgba(15, 18, 30, .20);
  --text-1: #0E1116;
  --text-2: #5E6573;
  --text-3: #686F7D;

  --accent: #C42B21;
  --accent-hover: #A62119;
  --accent-ink: #FFFFFF;
  --focus: #C42B21;

  --success: #2C6E4B; --success-bg: rgba(44, 110, 75, .10);
  --warn: #8A6512;    --warn-bg: rgba(138, 101, 18, .10);
  --danger: #A33D2E;  --danger-bg: rgba(163, 61, 46, .10);

  --e-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .10);
  --e-2: 0 6px 20px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14);
  --e-3: 0 20px 48px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .20);

  /* SIGNATURE · glass, light: white translucency + soft neutral-grey shadow,
     no color in shadows */
  --glass-fill-3: rgba(255, 255, 255, .72);
  --glass-border: rgba(15, 18, 30, .08);
  --glass-shadow: 0 2px 5px -3px rgba(40, 46, 70, .18), 0 7px 16px -11px rgba(40, 46, 70, .28);
  --glass-glow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(15, 18, 30, .03);
  --glass-inset: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .95), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(15, 18, 30, .05);
  --surface-body: linear-gradient(168deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, .5) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, .16) 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 60%);

  /* SIGNATURE · navshell, light: main pill BRIGHT on recessed grey frame
     (main leads) */
  --nav-frame: rgba(26, 32, 52, .10);
  --nav-main: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92);
  --nav-pill-inset: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .9), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgba(15, 18, 30, .06), 0 3px 8px -3px rgba(40, 46, 70, .16);

  --data-alt: #1D6FD8;

  --accent-on: var(--accent-hover);
  --accent-bloom: radial-gradient(120% 150% at 50% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent) 44%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 72%, transparent 100%);
  --accent-active-glow: none;
}
</style>
<style>
/* ============================================================================
   @verseva/design · components.css
   The component contract rendered as CSS. Framework-light: plain classes on
   the tokens; no build step required. Values are extracted VERBATIM from the
   design board's specimen CSS (board/index.html renders every class below in
   every contract state). Renames from board-only specimen names are noted
   inline; specimen scaffolding (device frames, state simulators' wrappers)
   is not shipped.

   Contract floor (docs/component-contract.md): all states shipped, 2px
   focus-visible ring, ≥44px touch targets, 4.5:1 labels / 3:1 parts, never
   color-alone, motion on transform/opacity via the duration/easing tokens.
   ========================================================================= */

/* ---- Button ---- */
.btn{
  appearance:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-sans);
  font-weight:var(--btn-weight);font-size:.9375rem;line-height:1;
  height:40px;padding:0 var(--s-4);border-radius:var(--r-btn);
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);
  transition:background var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),transform var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),box-shadow var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard);
}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg),0 0 0 4px var(--focus)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--accent-fill,var(--accent));color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-fill-hover,var(--accent-hover))}
.btn-secondary{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--hairline);color:var(--text-1)}
.btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--text-1)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.btn-destructive{background:var(--danger-bg);color:var(--danger);border:1px solid transparent}
.btn-destructive:hover{border-color:var(--danger)}
.btn.sm{height:32px;padding:0 var(--s-3);font-size:.875rem}
.btn.lg{height:48px;padding:0 var(--s-5);font-size:1rem}
.btn.icon{width:40px;padding:0;justify-content:center}
.btn.sm.icon{width:32px}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn:disabled,.btn.is-disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.spinner{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;animation:dc-spin .7s linear infinite}
@keyframes dc-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* ---- Input / field ---- */
.field{display:grid;gap:var(--s-2)}
.field label{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500}
.field input{
  height:40px;padding:0 var(--s-3);border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  border:1px solid var(--hairline);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text-1);
  font:inherit;font-size:.9375rem;
  transition:border-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),box-shadow var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard);
}
.field input::placeholder{color:var(--text-3)}
.field input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--focus);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 25%,transparent)}
.field .help{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text-3)}
.field.error input{border-color:var(--danger)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--danger)}
.field input:disabled{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-3);cursor:not-allowed}

/* ---- Selection controls ---- */
.sel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);font-size:.9375rem;cursor:pointer}
.sel input{accent-color:var(--accent);width:18px;height:18px}
/* 1.4.0: two-line choice (label over a .metaline), one native radio or checkbox, 44px hit area */
.sel.two-line{align-items:flex-start;min-height:44px;padding:var(--s-2) 0}
.sel.two-line input{margin-top:2px;flex:none}
.sel.two-line .tx{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
.sel.two-line .metaline{font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--text-2)}
.switch{position:relative;width:40px;height:22px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--hairline);transition:background var(--dur-2) var(--ease-standard)}
.switch::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text-2);transition:transform var(--dur-2) var(--ease-standard),background var(--dur-2) var(--ease-standard)}
.sel input:checked+.switch{background:var(--accent);border-color:transparent}
.sel input:checked+.switch::after{transform:translateX(18px);background:var(--accent-ink)}
.sel input.sw{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:40px;height:22px;margin:0;cursor:pointer}
.sel.switch-wrap{position:relative}
.sel input.sw:focus-visible+.switch{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg),0 0 0 4px var(--focus)}

/* ---- Card (board name: .card-demo; specimen max-width dropped) ---- */
.card{border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--e-1);overflow:hidden}
.card .hd{padding:var(--s-4) var(--s-5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.card .hd h4{font-size:1rem;font-weight:600}
.card .bd{padding:var(--s-5);color:var(--text-2);font-size:.9375rem}
.card .ft{padding:var(--s-3) var(--s-5);border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:var(--s-2)}

/* ---- Top navigation bar (board name: .nav-demo) ---- */
.topnav{border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-5);padding:0 var(--s-5);height:60px}
.topnav nav{display:flex;gap:var(--s-4);flex:1}
.topnav nav a{text-decoration:none;font-size:.9375rem;color:var(--text-2)}
.topnav nav a.active{color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent);padding-bottom:2px}

/* ---- Table (board name: .table-demo) ---- */
.table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.9375rem}
/* Header labels are human words: quiet sentence-case body, never tracked mono (law 4) */
.table th{text-align:left;font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-2);padding:var(--s-3) var(--s-3);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.table td{padding:var(--s-3);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
/* 1.5.0: every cell centres vertically, so a two-line identity beside one-line cells and controls lines up */
.table th,.table td{vertical-align:middle}
.table tr:hover td{background:var(--surface-2)}
.table .num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* 1.4.0: identity cell, name over email; the email never truncates */
.table .ident{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
.table .ident b{font-weight:600;color:var(--text-1);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.table .ident small{font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--text-2);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.table th.num{text-align:right}

/* ---- Pinned list header (contract: long lists only, opt-in on the wrapper) ----
   Pins under the surface's sticky chrome (--sticky-top). overflow:clip, never hidden:
   hidden makes a scroller and the header silently stops pinning. Below 1024px, or
   with .box, the wrapper is the capped scroll box and the header pins to its top. */
.pin{overflow:clip}
.pin thead th,.pin .pin-head{position:sticky;top:var(--sticky-top,0px);z-index:2;background:var(--surface)}
.pin thead th{border-bottom:0;box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--hairline)}
.pin.box{overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - var(--sticky-top,0px) - var(--sticky-bottom,0px) - var(--s-4))}
.pin.box thead th,.pin.box .pin-head{top:0}
@media (max-width:1023px){
  .pin{overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100dvh - var(--sticky-top,0px) - var(--sticky-bottom,0px) - var(--s-4))}
  .pin thead th,.pin .pin-head{top:0}
}

/* ---- Bounded section (contract: no section's height grows with its data) ----
   .bounded wraps a list, feed or table; .bounded-rows marks the element whose children are
   the rows (.lrows, a tbody, an ol). Rows past the cap are dropped here, whatever the host
   sends: 5 by default, data-cap="1" to "12" per instance, and any other value falls back
   to 5, so no value leaves a section unbounded. The foot holds the count (.bounded-more,
   always there, with text only above the cap) and the Show all action (.bounded-all, a
   neutral .btn), together on the trailing edge. No motion. */
.bounded{min-width:0}
.bounded-name{margin:0 0 var(--s-3);font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:var(--heading-weight);font-size:1rem;color:var(--text-1)}
.bounded:not([data-cap="6"],[data-cap="7"],[data-cap="8"],[data-cap="9"],[data-cap="10"],[data-cap="11"],[data-cap="12"]) .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+6),
.bounded[data-cap="1"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+2),
.bounded[data-cap="2"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+3),
.bounded[data-cap="3"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+4),
.bounded[data-cap="4"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+5),
.bounded[data-cap="6"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+7),
.bounded[data-cap="7"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+8),
.bounded[data-cap="8"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+9),
.bounded[data-cap="9"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+10),
.bounded[data-cap="10"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+11),
.bounded[data-cap="11"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+12),
.bounded[data-cap="12"] .bounded-rows>:nth-child(n+13){display:none}
/* dividers sit above each row, so the last row on screen ends the same at the cap and past it */
.bounded-rows>.lrow,.bounded-rows>tr>td{border-bottom:0}
.bounded-rows>.lrow+.lrow,.bounded-rows>tr+tr>td{border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
/* a table outside a glass panel closes with a line above the foot; glass draws its own edge */
.bounded .table{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.glass .bounded .table,.bounded .glass .table{border-bottom:0}
.bounded .empty{border-radius:var(--r-md)}
/* the seam above the foot belongs to its parts: an empty count and no action leave no room behind */
.bounded-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:var(--s-3)}
.bounded-more{margin:var(--s-3) 0 0;font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--text-2)}
.bounded-more:empty{margin:0}
.bounded-all{margin-top:var(--s-3)}
@media (pointer:coarse){.bounded-all{min-height:44px}}
/* Show all is for a section with rows it is not showing: it renders at the cap and above. Below
   the cap it is dropped, unless data-all="always" keeps it for a scoped view that adds filters
   or sorting, and never while the count has text (a short first page with more rows behind it).
   Kept apart from the cap rules: a browser without :has still caps the rows and holds the
   height, and shows the action below the cap as well. */
.bounded:not([data-all="always"],[data-cap="1"],[data-cap="2"],[data-cap="3"],[data-cap="4"],[data-cap="6"],[data-cap="7"],[data-cap="8"],[data-cap="9"],[data-cap="10"],[data-cap="11"],[data-cap="12"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(5))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="1"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(1))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="2"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(2))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="3"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(3))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="4"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(4))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="6"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(6))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="7"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(7))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="8"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(8))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="9"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(9))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="10"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(10))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="11"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(11))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all,
.bounded[data-cap="12"]:not([data-all="always"]):not(:has(.bounded-rows>:nth-child(12))):not(:has(.bounded-more:not(:empty))) .bounded-all{display:none}

/* ---- Badge / status chip (always paired with text, never a dot alone) ---- */
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.01em;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-pill)}
.badge svg{width:10px;height:10px}
.badge.ok{color:var(--success);background:var(--success-bg)}

/* Icon button (gear, bell, guides, drawer close): count badge + unread dot */
.ibtn{position:relative;width:32px;height:32px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:none;color:var(--text-2);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),transform var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.ibtn:hover,.ibtn[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-1)}
.capsule .ibtn:hover,.capsule .ibtn[aria-expanded="true"]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-1) 6%,var(--surface-2))}
.ibtn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.ibtn:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.ibtn:disabled,.ibtn[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.ibtn svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.ibtn .num{position:absolute;top:2px;right:0;min-width:16px;height:16px;padding:0 4px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--text-1);color:var(--bg);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;line-height:16px;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg)}
.ibtn .dot{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text-1);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg)}
@media (pointer:coarse){.ibtn{width:44px;height:44px}.cside .snav a,.collapse-row,.acct,.platform{min-height:44px}}

/* Platform mark + version (opens What's new) */
.platform{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);padding:var(--s-1) var(--s-2) 2px;border:0;border-radius:calc(var(--r-sm) - 2px);background:none;color:var(--text-2);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),transform var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.platform:hover{color:var(--text-1)}
.platform:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.platform:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.platform .pmark{display:inline-flex;height:14px}
.platform .pmark svg,.platform .pmark img{height:14px;width:auto;display:block}
.platform .pmark .on-light,[data-theme="light"] .platform .pmark .on-dark{display:none}
[data-theme="light"] .platform .pmark .on-light{display:block}
.platform .v{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px}

/* Top bar: breadcrumb, search, notifications, guides; a header divides content */
.tbar{position:sticky;top:var(--sticky-top,0px);z-index:12;height:60px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);padding:0 var(--s-4) 0 var(--s-6);background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.tbar .crumbs{min-width:150px}
.tbar .searchbox{flex:0 1 360px;max-width:none;margin-inline:auto;padding:7px 12px}
.tbar-end{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-1);margin-left:auto}
.tbar .searchbox+.tbar-end{margin-left:0}

/* Notifications panel (a non-modal dialog under the bell) */
.menu-list.panel{width:340px;padding:0;gap:0;overflow:hidden}
.panel-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);padding:var(--s-3) 14px var(--s-2)}
.panel-hd h4{flex:1;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.panel-hd button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--text-2);font:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.panel-hd button:hover{color:var(--text-1)}
.panel-hd button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.panel-hd button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.notifs{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-height:min(420px,60vh);overflow-y:auto}
.notifs:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}
.notif{display:flex;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);background:none;color:var(--text-1);font:inherit;font-size:13px;text-align:left}
button.notif,a.notif{cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:background var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.notif.unread{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 5%,transparent)}
button.notif:hover,a.notif:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.notif:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}
.notif .avc{width:28px;height:28px}
.notif .avc svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.notif .tx{flex:1;min-width:0}
.notif .tx b{font-weight:600}
.notif .metaline{display:block;margin-top:1px}
.notif.unread .metaline{color:var(--text-2)}
.notif .udot{width:7px;height:7px;margin-top:6px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--text-1)}
.panel-empty{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);padding:var(--s-5) 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2);text-align:center}
.panel-ft{display:block;width:100%;padding:9px 14px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);background:none;color:var(--text-2);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.panel-ft:hover{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-1)}
.panel-ft:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}

/* What's new: right sheet over a scrim; scrim one beat faster than the sheet */
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:16;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 45%,transparent);animation:dc-fade var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:var(--s-3);right:var(--s-3);bottom:var(--s-3);z-index:17;width:min(400px,calc(100vw - var(--s-5)));display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--e-3);animation:dc-sheet var(--dur-2) var(--ease-entrance) backwards}
.scrim[hidden],.drawer[hidden]{display:none}
@keyframes dc-sheet{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(16px)}}
.drawer-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:var(--s-4) var(--s-4) var(--s-3) 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.drawer-hd h4{flex:1;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:var(--heading-weight);font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.vchip{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-1);background:var(--surface-2);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:2px 9px}
.drawer-bd{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:var(--s-1) 20px var(--s-4)}
.drawer-bd:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}
.drawer .rel{padding:14px 0 6px}
.drawer .rel+.rel{border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.drawer .relhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);margin-bottom:10px}
.drawer .relhead h5{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600}
.drawer .relhead time{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3)}
.drawer .chgs{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.drawer .chg{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline;padding:5px 0;font-size:13.5px}
.drawer .chg .k{flex:none;width:66px}
.drawer .chg .k .badge{padding:1px 8px;font-size:11px}
.drawer .rel.seen .chg{color:var(--text-2)}
.drawer .empty{border:0;border-radius:0}
/* New: text ladder, not the accent (law 3 budget: info badges are neutral); text-1 and weight set it above Improved */
.badge.bloom{color:var(--text-1);background:var(--surface-2);font-weight:600}

/* Rail (.cside[data-collapsed]): 72px, icons only; names visually hidden (never display:none); urgent counts become dots */
.cside[data-collapsed]{width:72px}
.cside[data-collapsed] :is(.snav .nl,.snav .cnt:not(.hot),.oname,.who,.collapse-row span,.platform .v){position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;margin:-1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.cside[data-collapsed] :is(.grouplabel,.sgroup-head,.switcher .chev,.collapse-row kbd,.oword){display:none}
.cside[data-collapsed] .switcher{justify-content:center;padding:6px}
.cside[data-collapsed] .switcher.word .otile{display:grid}
.cside[data-collapsed] .sgroup{margin-top:0}
.cside[data-collapsed] .sgroup+.sgroup{margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.cside[data-collapsed] .snav{gap:var(--s-1)}
.cside[data-collapsed] .snav[hidden]{display:grid}
.cside[data-collapsed] .snav a{justify-content:center;padding:9px 0}
.cside[data-collapsed] .snav a svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.cside[data-collapsed] .snav .ni{display:grid;place-items:center;width:18px;height:18px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.cside[data-collapsed] .snav .cnt.hot{position:absolute;top:5px;right:9px;width:8px;height:8px;padding:0;border:0;overflow:hidden;color:transparent;background:var(--text-1);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg)}
.cside[data-collapsed] .collapse-row{justify-content:center;padding:9px 0}
.cside[data-collapsed] .collapse-row svg{transform:scaleX(-1)}
.cside[data-collapsed] .capsule{flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:var(--s-1);padding:var(--s-1) 2px}
.cside[data-collapsed] .acct{flex:none;padding:var(--s-1)}
.cside[data-collapsed] .platform{justify-content:center;padding-inline:0}
.cside[data-collapsed] .menu-list.full{right:auto;width:260px}
.cside[data-collapsed] .menu-list.up{width:220px}
/* Rail tip: one fixed label beside the hovered or focused rail control; script sets --rt-x / --rt-y */
.railtip{position:fixed;left:var(--rt-x,0px);top:var(--rt-y,0px);z-index:15;transform:translateY(-50%);width:max-content;max-width:220px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--text-1);color:var(--bg);font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--e-2)}
.railtip[hidden]{display:none}

/* ---- Stat tile / KPI ---- */
.statrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:var(--s-4)}
.stat{border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface);padding:var(--s-4);box-shadow:var(--e-1)}
.stat .num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:var(--display-weight);font-size:2.1rem;line-height:1.05;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.stat .num i{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
.stat .lbl{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text-3);margin-top:2px}
.stat .delta{margin-top:8px}

/* ---- Charts (takeaway captions are mandatory: label the meaning) ---- */
.chartcard{border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface);padding:var(--s-4);box-shadow:var(--e-1)}
.chartcard h4{font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:600}
.chartcard .sub{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text-3);margin-bottom:12px}
.takeaway{margin-top:12px;font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--text-2);border-top:1px solid var(--hairline);padding-top:9px}
.bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;height:130px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--chart-grid,var(--hairline));padding:0 2px}
.bar{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:100%;cursor:default}
.bar .fill{width:100%;max-width:34px;background:var(--data-3,var(--accent));border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;transition:opacity var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.bar .fill[data-l="0"]{background:var(--data-0)}
.bar .fill[data-l="1"]{background:var(--data-1)}
.bar .fill[data-l="2"]{background:var(--data-2)}
.bar:hover .fill{opacity:.82}
.bar .mlab{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--chart-label,var(--text-3))}
.bar .vlab{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-2)}
/* Withheld data (1.7.1). A suppressed bar is a short hatched stub, the same height whatever was withheld,
   so it never reads as a value (a tall slot reads as the biggest bar) or as a loading skeleton. The hatch is
   the text ladder over nothing (law 11: a hairline cannot carry meaning), never the accent. The display
   ("<5") sits on the stub in the value's own face and size, on the baseline of its neighbours' numbers. */
.bar .vtrack{flex:none;width:100%;max-width:34px;height:var(--s-3);border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--text-3) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px)}
.heat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(14,1fr);gap:3px}
.heat span{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:5px;background:var(--data-0);cursor:default}
.heat span.d1{background:var(--data-1)}
.heat span.d2{background:var(--data-2)}
.heat span.d3{background:var(--data-3)}
.heatlegend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:10px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-3)}
.heatlegend span{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block}

/* ---- Field extensions: select + textarea (same contract as input) ---- */
.field select,.field textarea{padding:0 var(--s-3);border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:1px solid var(--hairline);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text-1);font:inherit;font-size:.9375rem;transition:border-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),box-shadow var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.field select{height:40px}
.field textarea{min-height:96px;padding:var(--s-3);resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.field select:focus-visible,.field textarea:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--focus);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 25%,transparent)}
.field.error select,.field.error textarea{border-color:var(--danger)}

/* ---- Tab bar (in-page sections; the underline is accent, never a hairline) ---- */
.tabbar{display:flex;gap:var(--s-4);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.tabbar button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--text-2);font:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;padding:var(--s-2) 2px;cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.tabbar button:hover{color:var(--text-1)}
.tabbar [aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent)}
.tabbar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}

/* ---- Menu (dropdown) ---- */
.menu{position:relative;display:inline-block}
.menu-list{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;min-width:180px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--e-2);padding:6px;display:grid;gap:2px;z-index:15}
.menu-list[hidden]{display:none}
.menu-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:0;background:none;color:var(--text-1);font:inherit;font-size:13.5px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.menu-item:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.menu-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}
.menu-item.danger{color:var(--danger)}
.menu-sep{height:1px;background:var(--hairline);margin:4px 6px}
.menu.end .menu-list{left:auto;right:0}
.menu-item:disabled,.menu-item[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;background:none}
.menu-item[aria-busy="true"]{cursor:progress}
.menu-item[aria-busy="true"] .spinner{margin-left:auto;width:12px;height:12px;flex:none;color:var(--text-2)}
/* Checkable items (menuitemradio / menuitemcheckbox): the trailing tick carries the
   state with the weight, never color alone */
.menu-item .tick{margin-left:auto;width:14px;height:14px;flex:none;color:var(--text-1);opacity:0}
.menu-item>.badge{flex:none;white-space:nowrap}
.menu-item[aria-checked="true"]{font-weight:600}
.menu-item[aria-checked="true"] .tick{opacity:1}
/* Inline row menu: a ghost trigger wrapping the cell's own value (a status badge, an
   owner) so the value IS the control; pulled left so the value keeps its column edge */
.menu.inline>.btn{margin-left:calc(var(--s-2) * -1);padding:0 var(--s-2);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500}
.menu.inline>.btn .avc{width:22px;height:22px}
.menu.inline>.btn[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--surface-2)}

/* ---- Tooltip (inverse ground; keep the text short, it is not a doc).
   WCAG 1.4.13: hoverable (pointer-events restored while shown), dismissible
   (Escape via the react binding's .tiphide). ---- */
.tip{position:relative;display:inline-flex}
.tip .tipbox{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 8px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--text-1);color:var(--bg);padding:5px 10px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;width:max-content;max-width:220px;text-align:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard);z-index:15}
.tip:hover .tipbox,.tip:focus-within .tipbox{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.tip .tipbox.tiphide{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}

/* ---- Breadcrumbs ---- */
.crumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-3)}
.crumbs a{color:var(--text-2);text-decoration:none}
.crumbs a:hover{color:var(--text-1)}
.crumbs [aria-current="page"]{color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600}

/* ---- Pagination ---- */
.pager{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.pager button{min-width:32px;height:32px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:0;background:none;color:var(--text-2);font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pager button:hover{background:var(--surface-2)}
.pager [aria-current="page"]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent);color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600}
.pager button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default;background:none}

/* ---- Progress (pair with a real number; never color-alone) ---- */
.progress{height:6px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--hairline-soft);overflow:hidden}
.progress .fill{height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:4px;transition:width var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard)}

/* ---- Callout (status text on tints clears 4.5:1; the word leads) ---- */
.callout{display:flex;gap:var(--s-3);padding:var(--s-4) var(--s-5);border-radius:var(--r-md);font-size:13.5px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--hairline);color:var(--text-2)}
.callout b{color:var(--text-1);font-weight:600}
.callout.ok{background:var(--success-bg);border-color:transparent;color:var(--success)}
.callout.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:transparent;color:var(--warn)}
.callout.err{background:var(--danger-bg);border-color:transparent;color:var(--danger)}
.callout.ok b,.callout.warn b,.callout.err b{color:inherit}

/* ---- Empty state ---- */
.empty{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:var(--s-3);padding:var(--s-7) var(--s-5);text-align:center;border:1px dashed var(--hairline-strong);border-radius:var(--r-lg);color:var(--text-2);font-size:13.5px}
.empty b{color:var(--text-1);font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:var(--heading-weight);font-size:16px}

/* ---- Content accordion (native details; promoted from the storefront) ---- */
.acc{border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden}
.acc details + details{border-top:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.acc summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-3);padding:var(--s-3) var(--s-4);font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.acc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.acc summary::after{content:"+";color:var(--text-3)}
.acc details[open] summary::after{content:"\2013"}
.acc .accbody{padding:0 var(--s-4) var(--s-4);color:var(--text-2);font-size:13.5px}

/* ---- Data-viz kit (synthesized 2026-08-31 from the portfolio's shipped
   viz: Spectre and a production console).
   Doctrine carried in the classes: numbers ON the marks (no gridline
   forests; an axis is one hairline at most), denominator-first stats,
   deltas colored by MEANING not sign, one magnitude hue + the fixed
   --data-alt second series, identity never color-alone. ---- */

/* Stat micro-bar: a 4px proportional bar under a stat numeral */
.stat .microbar{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--surface-2);margin-top:8px;overflow:hidden}
.stat .microbar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:2px;background:var(--data-3)}

/* Trend delta: direction is the arrow, judgment is the class */
.trend{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.trend.good{color:var(--success)}
.trend.bad{color:var(--danger)}
.trend.flat{color:var(--text-3)}

/* Horizontal bar rows: label / track / mono count (axis-free) */
.hbars{display:grid;gap:8px}
.hbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-3);font-size:12.5px}
.hbar .hlabel{width:88px;flex:none;color:var(--text-2);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.hbar .htrack{height:8px;min-width:0;flex:1;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden}
.hbar .htrack i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--data-3)}
.hbar .htrack i.alt{background:var(--data-alt)}
.hbar[data-suppressed] .htrack{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--text-3) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px);background-size:var(--s-4) 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.hbar .hcount{width:40px;flex:none;text-align:right;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--text-1)}

/* Activity strip + calendar cells: ONE intensity language via the ladder */
.actstrip{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;gap:4px}
.actstrip i,.actcal i{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:4px;background:var(--data-0)}

/* Ring: rotate the svg, number inside the dial, label BELOW it

.spark{height:40px}

.viztip span[data-withheld]{color:var(--text-2)}
/* The gap band under a line: the bar stub's hatch, --s-1 tall, below the zero baseline by 2 plot units or
   --s-1, whichever is larger, and never on it. HTML over the plot's frame, so the hatch keeps its angle
   however the svg stretches. An all-null chart also says the withheld word, centred in the plot. */
.vizframe{display:block;position:relative;height:100%}
.vizgap{position:absolute;top:max(var(--vizband-top),calc(var(--vizband-base) + var(--s-1)));height:var(--s-1);background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--text-3) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px);pointer-events:none}

/* ---- Console recipes (1.2.0, promoted from the Studio CRM) ---- */

/* Glass panel (law 1 soft-glass on a content panel): .navshell's container material
   verbatim (fill + border + shadow/glow/inset) under .navmain's catch-light body, at
   the card radius. No blur: panels scroll, blur is for fixed chrome only. Overflow
   stays visible so row menus escape the panel; the last row rounds itself. Meta text
   inside lifts to --text-2: the catch-light brightens the panel's top rows. Pairs with
   .stat and .chartcard on the same element (.stat.glass). */
.glass{background:var(--surface-body),var(--glass-fill-3);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--glass-shadow),var(--glass-glow),var(--glass-inset);overflow:visible}

.glass .metaline,.glass .lbl,.glass .sub,.glass .help{color:var(--text-2)}
.glass .field.error .help{color:var(--danger)}
.glass .lrows{border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent}
.glass .lrow:hover,.glass .table tr:hover td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-1) 4%,transparent)}
.glass .table th{padding:var(--s-3) var(--s-4)}
.glass .table td{padding:var(--s-2) var(--s-4);height:52px}
.glass .table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}

.glass .table tbody tr:last-child td:last-child,.glass>.lrows:last-child{border-bottom-right-radius:var(--r-md)}
.glass .empty{border:0;border-radius:0}

/* List rows as links: whole row is the target */
a.lrow{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
a.lrow:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}

/* Read-only field list (view first, edit on intent): a <dl>, label above value.
   An empty value is a quiet .unset word, never a blank row. */
.kv{display:grid;margin:0}
.kv>div{display:grid;gap:2px;min-width:0;padding:var(--s-2) var(--s-4);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)}
.kv>div:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.kv dt{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-3)}
.glass .kv dt{color:var(--text-2)}
.kv dd{margin:0;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-1);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.kv dd .unset{font-weight:400;color:var(--text-2)}

.kv dd a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px}
.kv dd .skel{display:block;width:60%;height:12px;margin-top:4px}

/* Timeline (a record's activity, newest first): .lrows rows on an <ol>, the event
   type as an icon in the identity slot (quiet; no pill per row), time in <time> */
.tline{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.tline .avc svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.tline time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tline .lrow.new{animation:dc-rise var(--dur-3) var(--ease-entrance) backwards}

/* Confirm-to-erase (typed confirmation): the erase stays disabled until the exact
   phrase is typed, then arms as a solid danger fill (hierarchy from fill, law 8).
   Cancel holds default focus; Escape cancels. */
.modal.erase .field{margin-top:var(--s-4)}
.modal.erase .callout{margin-top:var(--s-4)}
.modal.erase .phrase{font-weight:600;color:var(--text-1);-webkit-user-select:all;user-select:all}
.modal.erase .ft .btn-destructive:not(:disabled){background:var(--danger);color:var(--bg)}
.modal.erase .ft .btn-destructive:not(:disabled):hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--danger) 86%,var(--text-1));border-color:transparent}

/* Bulk selection: a .pick column of row checkboxes, a tinted selected row, and the
   bulk bar. The bar is fixed chrome (sticky to the viewport bottom, above any floating
   nav via --sticky-bottom), so it carries the full glass material WITH blur. */
.table th.pick,.table td.pick{width:44px;padding-right:0}
.pick>label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;margin:calc(var(--s-3) * -1) 0 calc(var(--s-3) * -1) calc(var(--s-3) * -1);cursor:pointer}
.pick input{width:18px;height:18px;margin:0;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.pick input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.pick input:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.45}
.table tr[aria-selected="true"] td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 8%,transparent)}
.bulkbar{position:sticky;bottom:calc(var(--sticky-bottom,0px) + var(--s-4));z-index:12;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);width:max-content;max-width:100%;margin-inline:auto;padding:var(--s-2) var(--s-2) var(--s-2) var(--s-4);border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:var(--surface-body),var(--glass-fill-3);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-sat));backdrop-filter:blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-sat));border:1px solid var(--glass-border);box-shadow:var(--glass-shadow),var(--glass-glow),var(--glass-inset);animation:dc-rise var(--dur-2) var(--ease-entrance) backwards}
.bulkbar[hidden]{display:none}
.bulkbar .count{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--text-1);padding-right:var(--s-3);margin-right:var(--s-1);border-right:1px solid var(--hairline);white-space:nowrap}
.bulkbar[aria-busy="true"] .btn{pointer-events:none}
@media (max-width:767px){.bulkbar{width:auto;margin-inline:0;flex-wrap:wrap}.bulkbar .count{margin-right:auto;border-right:0}}

/* ---- Widgets (1.6.0): grid, tile, edit mode, smart stack, gallery ---- */
/* Grid: 4 columns, 2 under 1100px, 1 under 560px of viewport. Container mode is opt-in: inside
   .wgrid-wrap (the React part's container prop renders it) the grid counts from the wrapper's
   width instead, 4 columns from 688px (four 160px small tiles and three gaps), 2 from 560px,
   1 below. Sparse row flow (never dense), so DOM order, focus order and visual order agree. Each
   tile picks its view from data-size; the React grid writes the fitted size, so L and XL show
   their M view in one column. */
.wgrid-wrap{container:wgrid / inline-size;width:100%;min-width:0}
.wgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:180px;grid-auto-flow:row;gap:var(--s-4);width:100%}

.wtile[data-size="s"]{grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1}
.wtile[data-size="m"]{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 1}
.wtile[data-size="l"]{grid-column:span 2;grid-row:span 2}
.wtile[data-size="xl"]{grid-column:span 4;grid-row:span 2}
.wtile-body{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--s-2);padding:var(--s-4);overflow:hidden;border-radius:inherit}
.wtile-body:has(>.wstack){padding:0}
.wtile-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);min-width:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-2)}
.wtile-hd svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex:none}
.wtile-meta{margin-left:auto;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-2);white-space:nowrap}
.wtile-num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:var(--display-weight);font-size:30px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.wtile[data-size="s"] .wtile-num{font-size:28px}
.wtile[data-size="l"] .wtile-num,.wtile[data-size="xl"] .wtile-num{font-size:36px}

.wtile-rows{display:grid;gap:2px}
.wtile-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s-2);min-height:28px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2)}

/* States: hover, focus-visible (tiles take focus in edit mode), press, disabled, loading, error, empty */
.wtile:hover{border-color:var(--hairline-strong)}
.wtile:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.wtile[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45}

.wtile-skel{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--s-2)}
.wtile-skel .skel{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-1) 8%,transparent)}
.wtile-skel-num.skel{height:28px;width:55%}
.wtile-skel-plot.skel{flex:1;min-height:24px;height:auto;border-radius:var(--r-sm)}

/* Edit mode: jiggle is rotation only; content goes quiet; remove, size, move and handle appear */
.wgrid[data-editing] .wtile{cursor:grab;animation:wtile-jiggle var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard) infinite alternate}
.wgrid[data-editing] .wtile:nth-child(2n){animation-delay:calc(var(--dur-3) * -.5)}

.wtile-x,.wtile-edit,.wtile-handle{display:none}

.wgrid[data-editing] .wtile-edit{display:flex}
.wtile-x,.wtile-handle{position:absolute;top:0;z-index:2;width:44px;height:44px;place-items:center;padding:0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text-1);cursor:pointer}
.wtile-x{left:0}

.wtile-x::before,.wtile-handle::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--hairline-strong);transition:background var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),transform var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.wtile-x svg,.wtile-handle svg{position:relative;width:14px;height:14px}
.wtile-x:hover{color:var(--danger)}

.wtile-handle:hover::before{background:var(--surface)}

.wtile-x:active::before,.wtile-handle:active::before{transform:scale(.92)}
.wtile-x:active,.wtile-handle:active{cursor:grabbing}
.wtile-x[aria-disabled="true"],.wtile-handle[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.wtile-edit{position:absolute;inset:44px 0 0;z-index:2;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:var(--s-2);padding:0 0 var(--s-2);pointer-events:none}
.wtile-edit>*{pointer-events:auto}
.wtile-sizes,.wtile-move{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--hairline);box-shadow:var(--e-1)}

.wtile-sizes button:hover,.wtile-move button:hover{color:var(--text-1);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text-1) 6%,transparent)}
.wtile-sizes button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text-1);box-shadow:var(--e-1)}
.wtile-sizes button:focus-visible,.wtile-move button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:-2px}
.wtile-sizes button:active,.wtile-move button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.wtile-sizes button[aria-disabled="true"],.wtile-move button[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.wtile-sizes button[aria-disabled="true"]:hover,.wtile-move button[aria-disabled="true"]:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--text-2)}
/* The handle is the touch reorder (HTML drag does not fire on iOS); fine pointers drag the tile itself */
@media (pointer:fine){.wgrid[data-editing] .wtile-handle{display:none}}
.wgrid-add{grid-column:span 1;grid-row:span 1;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--s-2);border:1.5px dashed var(--hairline-strong);border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:transparent;color:var(--text-2);font:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),border-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard),transform var(--dur-1) var(--ease-standard)}
.wgrid-add svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.wgrid-add:hover{color:var(--text-1);border-color:var(--text-2)}
.wgrid-add:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.wgrid-add:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.wgrid-add[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

.wgrid-undo .toast .btn{margin-left:var(--s-2);min-height:44px;color:var(--text-1);font-size:.875rem}

/* Accent budget (law 3, one accent per view): charts in a tile draw on the text ladder; only the
   widget the product marks focus keeps the viz kit's accent. */
.wtile:not([data-focus]) .bar .fill,.wtile:not([data-focus]) .stat .microbar i,.wtile:not([data-focus]) .hbar .htrack i,.wtile:not([data-focus]) .markstrip i.current,.wtile:not([data-focus]) .vizlegend i{background:var(--text-1)}
.wtile:not([data-focus]) .hbar .htrack i.alt,.wtile:not([data-focus]) .vizlegend i.alt{background:var(--data-alt)}
.wtile:not([data-focus]) .ring .ringfill{stroke:var(--text-1)}
.wtile:not([data-focus]) .stat .num i{color:var(--text-1)}

.wtile:not([data-focus]) .actstrip i.today,.wtile:not([data-focus]) .actcal i.today{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--text-2)}
.wtile:not([data-focus]) [stroke="var(--data-3)"]{stroke:var(--text-1)}
.wtile:not([data-focus]) [fill="var(--data-3)"]{fill:var(--text-1)}
.wtile:not([data-focus]) [stop-color="var(--data-3)"]{stop-color:var(--text-1)}

/* Smart stack: one slot, several widgets; scroll, swipe, dots or a timer with a visible pause */
.wstack{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;touch-action:pan-y}
.wstack-pages{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0}
.wstack-page{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--s-2);padding:var(--s-4) 0 var(--s-4) var(--s-4);transition:opacity var(--dur-3) var(--ease-standard),transform var(--dur-3) var(--ease-emph)}
.wstack-page[data-pos="prev"]{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-18px);pointer-events:none}

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const slides = [...document.querySelectorAll('.deck-slide')];
  const n = slides.length;
  if (!n) return;
  const count = document.querySelector('.deck-count');
  const fill = document.querySelector('.deck-bar i');
  const prev = document.querySelector('.deck-prev');
  const next = document.querySelector('.deck-next');
  let at = -1;

  const fromHash = () => {
    const k = Number.parseInt(location.hash.slice(1), 10);
    return Number.isInteger(k) && k >= 1 && k <= n ? k - 1 : 0;
  };

  function show(k) {
    k = Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, k));
    if (k === at) return;
    const back = k < at;
    at = k;
    slides.forEach((s, i) => {
      const on = i === k;
      s.classList.toggle('deck-on', on);
      s.classList.toggle('deck-back', !on && back);
      s.toggleAttribute('inert', !on);
      if (!on) s.querySelectorAll('.deck-src[open]').forEach((d) => { d.open = false; });
    });
    count.textContent = `${k + 1} / ${n}`;
    fill.style.transform = `scaleX(${(k + 1) / n})`;
    prev.disabled = k === 0;
    next.disabled = k === n - 1;
    if (location.hash !== `#${k + 1}`) history.replaceState(null, '', `#${k + 1}`);
  }

  root.classList.add('deck-paged');
  show(fromHash());

  prev.addEventListener('click', () => show(at - 1));
  next.addEventListener('click', () => show(at + 1));
  addEventListener('hashchange', () => show(fromHash()));

  addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const onControl = e.target instanceof Element && e.target.closest('summary, button, a, input, textarea, select');
    const open = document.querySelector('.deck-src[open]');
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && open) { open.open = false; open.querySelector('summary').focus(); return; }
    if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') && onControl) return;
    const step = { ArrowRight: 1, ArrowDown: 1, PageDown: 1, ' ': e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1, ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowUp: -1, PageUp: -1 }[e.key];
    if (step) { e.preventDefault(); show(at + step); return; }
    if (e.key === 'Home') { e.preventDefault(); show(0); }
    if (e.key === 'End') { e.preventDefault(); show(n - 1); }
  });

  /* A swipe: a mostly horizontal drag of at least 48px. */
  let x0 = null, y0 = null, lastX = null, lastY = null;
  addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    if (e.touches.length !== 1) { x0 = null; return; }
    x0 = e.touches[0].clientX; y0 = e.touches[0].clientY;
    lastX = lastY = null;
  }, { passive: true });
  addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    if (x0 === null || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    lastX = e.touches[0].clientX; lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
  }, { passive: true });
  addEventListener('touchend', () => {
    if (x0 === null || lastX === null) { x0 = null; return; }
    const dx = lastX - x0, dy = lastY - y0;
    x0 = lastX = lastY = null;
    if (Math.abs(dx) >= 48 && Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) show(at + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1));
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
